name: work-table-toolbar
title: Work table toolbar
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Search, priority toggle, assignee multiselect, cycle select, and sort menu for a work table.

"use client" /** Filters for a work table: search, priority, people, cycle, and sort. */ import type { ReactElement } from "react" import { ChevronDown, Maximize2, RotateCcw, Search, Undo2 } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip" import { WORK_PRIORITIES, WORK_SORT_KEYS, type WorkPriority, type WorkSortDir, type WorkSortKey } from "@/lib/work-table" export type WorkToolbarPerson = { id: string name: string initials?: string imageUrl?: string | null } export type WorkCycle = { id: string; label: string } export type WorkToolbarLabels = { search: string priority: string assignee: string assigneeEmpty: string cycle: string cycleAll: string sort: string direction: string ascending: string descending: string sortManual: string sortDate: string sortPriority: string sortEffort: string reset: string expand: string collapse: string restore: string } export const defaultWorkToolbarLabels: WorkToolbarLabels = { search: "Buscar", priority: "Prioridad", assignee: "Responsable", assigneeEmpty: "Cualquiera", cycle: "Ciclo", cycleAll: "Todos los ciclos", sort: "Orden", direction: "Dirección", ascending: "Ascendente", descending: "Descendente", sortManual: "Manual", sortDate: "Fecha", sortPriority: "Prioridad", sortEffort: "Esfuerzo", reset: "Restablecer filtros", expand: "Expandir", collapse: "Contraer", restore: "Restaurar diseño", } const SORT_LABEL: Record = { manual: "sortManual", date: "sortDate", priority: "sortPriority", effort: "sortEffort", } export type WorkTableToolbarProps = { query: string onQueryChange: (value: string) => void priorities: readonly WorkPriority[] onPrioritiesChange: (value: WorkPriority[]) => void people?: readonly WorkToolbarPerson[] assignees: readonly string[] onAssigneesChange: (ids: string[]) => void cycles?: readonly WorkCycle[] cycle: string | null onCycleChange: (id: string | null) => void sortKey: WorkSortKey sortDir: WorkSortDir onSortChange: (key: WorkSortKey, dir: WorkSortDir) => void onReset?: () => void onExpand?: () => void onRestore?: () => void expanded?: boolean labels?: Partial className?: string } export function WorkTableToolbar({ query, onQueryChange, priorities, onPrioritiesChange, people = [], assignees, onAssigneesChange, cycles = [], cycle, onCycleChange, sortKey, sortDir, onSortChange, onReset, onExpand, onRestore, expanded = false, labels: labelOverrides, className, }: WorkTableToolbarProps) { const labels = { ...defaultWorkToolbarLabels, ...labelOverrides } const selectedPeople = people.filter((person) => assignees.includes(person.id)) function togglePriority(level: WorkPriority) { onPrioritiesChange(priorities.includes(level) ? priorities.filter((item) => item !== level) : [...priorities, level]) } function toggleAssignee(id: string) { onAssigneesChange(assignees.includes(id) ? assignees.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...assignees, id]) } return (

meta.titleEs: Barra de la tabla de trabajo
meta.descriptionEs: Búsqueda, prioridades P0–P3, responsables con avatar, ciclo y menú de orden.

examples.title: Barra
examples.description: Filtros controlados y botones de restablecer, expandir y restaurar.

meta.usage: <WorkTableToolbar query={query} onQueryChange={setQuery} priorities={priorities} onPrioritiesChange={setPriorities} people={people} assignees={assignees} onAssigneesChange={setAssignees} cycles={cycles} cycle={cycle} onCycleChange={setCycle} sortKey={sortKey} sortDir={sortDir} onSortChange={setSort} onReset={reset} />

api.name: query / priorities
api.description: Search text and the pressed P0–P3 levels.

api.name: people / assignees
api.description: Multiselect. Avatars show the selected people.

api.name: cycles / cycle
api.description: Single cycle. Null is every cycle.

api.name: sortKey / sortDir
api.description: Sort menu, including ascending and descending.

api.name: onReset / onExpand / onRestore
api.description: Optional icon buttons. Labels default to Spanish.

docs: Clean-room filter bar for the work table. No paid-library source or assets. It does not own the rows. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, popover, select, tooltip, or the shared work-table helpers. The item ships no theme.
